purpose: Write the video's own title and thumbnail hook from its evidence (owner instruction 2026-08-28: phrases picked per video, not one phrase for all videos). The model writes; deterministic templates remain the fallback for a machine without a model, and validation rejects anything off-evidence in shape: wrong length, empty lines, or Latin-only text on an Arabic channel. Temperature runs high on purpose -- two videos with similar evidence should still not share a sentence.

game.description: The detected game's display name, or the project name.

types.description: Dominant moment/event types with counts, in Arabic.

creatures.description: Distinctive on-screen names OCR captured, or '-'.

speech.description: A short sample of what was said, or '-'.
